title: Frontend: Sum of Subarray Minimum
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Sum of Subarray Minimum. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values). Return the exact sum of minimums of all nonempty contiguous subarrays. Values and results fit safe integers; duplicates and negatives are supported. Use a monotonic contribution stack.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
For each position count how many subarrays choose that element as their representative minimum, using distances to appropriate smaller boundaries.
alternativeApproaches: Return both minimum and maximum contribution totals and prove the asymmetric duplicate tie rule.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Equal values; increasing/decreasing sequence; one item.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
